description: Baromètre satisfaction client en gare is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Le baromètre de satisfaction client en gare est l’outil principal de mesure de la qualité perçue de SNCF Gares & Connexions. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Gares. Its keywords are Satisfaction client, Gare de voyageurs, Service en gare. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
